messages:
raj: alert — queued jobs in eu-west reserved pool spiked, admission control started throttling tenants automatically. queue_len=1240, admit_rate=15r/s, latency_p50=220ms
ops-bot: [ALERT] reserved-pool:eu-west-01 queue > 1k — fairshare-throttle engaged, alert-id=ALERT-98342
elyse: looking. is this coming from a single tenant or many?
raj: concentrated on tenant 'cntr-acme' with a few bursty tenants. traces show long-running sessions not releasing leases.
jin: can we force-evict idle leases or shorten lease TTL? /cc @sre-oncall
sre-oncall: our eviction window is 60m; current sessions avg ~45m. manual evict could impact customers. what's current preempt policy?
raj: policy=weight-based, preemptible=true, but session-affinity is preventing preempt from triggering cleanly. admission queue backlog prevents new fast requests.
elyse: I pushed a targeted admission config change to lower per-tenant concurrency in eu-west and increase short burst allowance for critical tenants. starting rolling update now.
raj: config diff applied (preview):
```
reserved_pool.eu-west.per_tenant_max = 100
reserved_pool.eu-west.burst_quota = 20
reserved_pool.eu-west.lease_ttl_override = 45m
```
jin: monitoring dashboards — seeing initial slope down in queue, still some tail. :eyes:
ops-bot: [DEPLOY] config-rollout eu-west applied by elyse at 1980012490, rollout-id=roll-4721
sre-oncall: ingress LB still shows elevated connections; temporarily routing overflow to us-west for cntr-acme. enabling cross-region fallback for that tenant.
elyse: enabled fallback for cntr-acme to us-west and ap-sg with TTL=30s. also added a short-term exception to avoid cold-start penalties.
raj: queue_len now ~180, admit_rate ~120r/s, latency p95 improving. will keep watch for 30m.
jin: follow-up items: add runbook entry for "reservation-hogging" pattern, create alert for session lease > 2h and add per-tenant slow-drain metric. I'll file ticket.
raj: filing ticket INF-4832: "eu-west reserved pool reservation-hogging — runbook + alerts" https://rwd/issues/INF-4832
sre-oncall: marking incident as mitigated for now; reopen if metrics creep back above thresholds. :white_check_mark:
